text:
oliver: heads up — customer 'AcmeRetail' reporting p95/p99 spike after we onboarded harbor-longctx-1.0 yesterday. 

oliver: they see p95 ~800ms -> 1.6s and p99 ~1.8s -> 4.2s on /v1/generate, mostly for long-context requests (>12k tokens). timeouts in some cases. :rotating_light:

maria: omg, they're on Dedicated cluster eu-west-2, right? any deploys in that region? :eyes:

opsbot: Alert: Deploy finished (harbor-longctx-1.0) — 2155501200 — prod-eu-west-2 — rolling.

jess: I'm digging into logs. initial hypothesis: tokenizer change introduced extra normalization pass + new byte-splitting heuristic that kills tokenization throughput for CJK-heavy inputs. saw spikes in tokenization_ms in traces.

kevin: attaching a flame snippet from runtime traces (sanitized):
```
harbor-longctx-1.0:tokenize  270ms (median 60ms)
decode_loop           55ms
kv_cache_lookup       20ms (miss rate 42%)
attention_kernels    120ms
total_request_time  2200ms (p99)
```

oliver: customer also pasted a repro curl. posting sanitized:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"harbor-longctx-1.0","input":"<~12k tokens example with mixed CJK + emojis>","max_tokens":512}'
```

maria: they reported intermittent 502/504s too. could be request queueing hitting proxy timeouts.

linh: checking infra metrics — queue length for harbor pool spiked around 14:20 UTC when the customer load hit a long-context batch. concurrent inflight for that pool went from 18 -> 70. autoscale didn't react fast enough due to a saturation on GPU memory because the new tokenizer increases peak sequence length after token expansion.

jess: repro locally with same payload: tokenizer step dominates. I ran a microbenchmark: harbor-tokenizer v1.4 does an extra normalization loop for emoji sequences. per-request tokenize_time +250ms on mixed inputs vs previous model.

kevin: mitigation options:
- rollback model rollout for affected customers to harbor-legacy-0.9 (fast path).
- enable per-customer fallback routing to compact variant harbor-longctx-lite.
- temporary increase proxy timeout to 10s for that route while we stabilize (risk: masks root cause).
- patch tokenizer to skip heavy normalization for requests flagged as "preserve_bytes" (quickfix).

oliver: customer asked for ETA and a workaround. Maria — can we route them to legacy today?

maria: I can pin them to harbor-legacy-0.9 for now. will need support from kevin to create route rule — low risk.

kevin: creating route rule now:
```json
{ "route": "acct-acmeretail", "model": "harbor-legacy-0.9", "duration": "48h", "reason": "tokenizer perf regression" }
```

kevin: applied. please verify from your side.

oliver: customer confirms reduced p99 to ~420ms after being pinned. thanks. :thumbsup:

jess: next steps for engineering:
- revert harbor tokenizer normalization change (PR ready, small diff)
- add tokenizer microbench to onboarding CI with mixed-language fixtures
- add telemetry for tokenization_ms per-request and alert when median > 80ms for a model pool

linh: ops follow-ups:
- tune autoscaler to consider tokenized sequence length expansion factor instead of raw client tokens
- add a hard cap on concurrent inflight per-pool with graceful queueing to avoid proxy timeouts

james: product note — flagging harbor-longctx-1.0 as "onboard: degraded" in model catalog and pausing rollout to new clusters until fixes verified.

support-bot: Ticket #INC-2024-1198 created and linked to AcmeRetail. SLA: response within 2h.

maria: customer asked for root-cause writeup and timeline. Jess — can you draft a short RCA we can share? include mitigation steps and ETA to rollout a patched tokenizer.

jess: will draft. ETA for patch + QA: 48-72h. quick patch to skip heavy normalization ~6-8h dev, 6h QA, then can do canary.

oliver: thanks everyone. keeping thread open until RCA posted and rollback verified in monitoring. :handshake:

maria: updating ticket and emailing customer with pinned route and monitoring link.

kevin: monitoring note — watching p95/p99 in prod-eu-west-2 harbor pool. set alert threshold at p99 > 1.5s.

oliver: last: capture of a failing stack (snippet) to include in RCA:
```
# tokenization stack sample
File "tokenizer.py", line 412, in normalize_emoji_sequences
  while regex.search(chunk):
File "re.py", line 234, in search
  return _compile(pattern, flags).search(string)
RuntimeError: maximum recursion depth exceeded
```

maria: noted. closing customer-facing update in 30m unless anything new.

jess: I'll post the RCA draft in this thread when ready.

oliver: thread locked for follow-ups — please ping if you need an unblock.
